commitment: This exact protocol is committed before source changes, evaluation and result inspection. Failure is reported, not optimized by using inspected seeds.
question: Can reuse of an already acquired external public-outcome bank across repeated checkpoint scenarios improve selective learning's aggregate acquisition-plus-TEST cost relative to fresh independent witness actions, without concealing upstream actor harm?

environment.world: Reuse ConditionalWorld private source->conditional->source->xor rules with inlet/outlet public schema, deterministic truthful outcomes and artificially stratified 5 productive/4 harmful/3 neutral candidate actions.
environment.base_train: Same independent one-action simulator actor, per seed source240, conditional128, source return64, XOR128. All base actor harm counts once and is common to policies.
environment.checkpoint_seeds: Each checkpoint has 16 held-out TEST episodes per seed, reused across checkpoints but never fed into learner. Checkpoints are counterfactual independent scenarios, NOT one continuous real-time learner trajectory.
environment.arm_A: Selective without extra evidence: unchanged ValidatedAbstainingMemory.
environment.arm_B: Fresh-on-demand independent witness: unchanged WitnessRecoveryMemory, up to four eight-action batches when public predictive adequacy fails; new TRAIN split actor episodes separately generated for EACH stage/checkpoint/seed; count harm per unique acquisition episode.
environment.arm_C: Pre-collected shared bank: one unique set of 32 first-action external actor outcomes PER STAGE/SEED (non-source stages only), acquired at that stage's entrance irrespective of whether learner later uses them. This bank is available to each checkpoint scenario; when adequacy is false, offer eight at a time in fixed order through unchanged WitnessRecoveryMemory API, up to 32. NEVER count bank actions repeatedly per checkpoint. Reuse of already-observed events does not make original actor actions passive/free; 32 actions already executed at stage entry.
environment.actor_episode_indices: Shared bank: 600000 + stage_number*10000 through +31. Fresh-on-demand: 650000 + stage_number*10000 + checkpoint_ordinal*100 through +31. Split=train. No actor episode index overlaps base TRAIN or TEST.
environment.outcomes: Truthful deterministic; no tests of stochastic noise, provenance authenticity or unseen operator invention. Neither evaluated policy initiates training actions.

metrics.task: successes, harmful TEST actions, abstained failed tasks and attempts per policy, all checkpoints.
metrics.acquisition: Unique base actor interventions and harm, shared bank actor interventions/harm counted ONCE per stage/seed even if never accepted, demand witness action harm counted per actual requested stage/seed/checkpoint. Separate consumed share counts from unique sourced counts.
metrics.global_cost: Across all independent checkpoint scenarios, weighted study loss = 10*(summed harmful TEST actions + unique extra acquisition harmful actions) + (summed failed-by-abstention tasks + unique extra acquisition actions). Base training-actor harm is identical for policies and displayed separately. This is one authored cost convention, not a universally valid risk valuation.
metrics.scopes: Study-wide cost aggregates TEST episodes across checkpoint scenarios as separate evaluation exposures even though indices repeat. They are not statistically independent, and source-bank costs are counted only once. ALSO report per-checkpoint raw metrics.

acceptance: At conditional32, shared bank policy succeeds on >=25 of 96 TEST tasks.
At source-return8, shared bank policy succeeds on >=25 of 96 TEST tasks.
Unique shared-bank acquisition actions across all phases/seeds < unique fresh-on-demand acquisition actions; disclose harm for both.
Report total authored study loss for all policies, even if shared bank loses. No automatic promotion regardless of which gates pass.
limits: The shared bank is pre-collected through real external simulator interventions, NOT passive sensing or harmless evidence. Its upfront harm must be counted even when unused.

The same bank is reused across counterfactual checkpoints but the actual task episodes for checkpoints are repeated. Study-wide loss is an accounting convention, not independent statistical trials or a deployable lifetime.
Witness interventions and held-out TEST outcomes never leak into policy selection except public actor outcomes collected prior to TEST.
The model remains incapable of expressing XOR, with fixed inherited uncalibrated adequacy and risk thresholds. False acceptance and harmful actions may remain.
No external permissions, default controller promotion, integration with AthenZ or Synveil, PR merge or roadmap D1–D10/V2A/V2B reordering.
